fields.summary_ko.0: Eli Lilly and Company (NYSE:LLY) stock price rose 2.35% following Jefferies' upward revision of price target to $1,700; current price is $1,385.56.
fields.summary_ko.1: Jefferies analyzes that the international obesity treatment market could exceed the size of the U.S. market, with the high-value GLP-1 drug portfolio identified as a key growth driver.
